newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures bounce to gains, peaks.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures bounce to gains, peaks.

text.p: April 8 - U.S. stock index futures bounced up to moderate gains, fresh session highs. Traders tied recovery partly to ability of T-bonds to close above lows. Rise powered by outside buying, some buystops above 769.50. June S&Ps cleared Monday's peak at 770.70, next resistance pegged at 772.50. But some looked for low-volume advance to peter out yet today.
